intentAndPurpose.intent: Non-interactive display component showing a numeric count with bold/subtle/ghost variants and multi-accent support.

props.name: value
props.description: Numeric count to display (code-only / Figma "dev → value" row). Required. Values above `max` render as `{max}+` (default `99+`). `0` is hidden unless `showZero`; negative values render as their string form.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Multi-accent appearance role. Figma public set omits `brand-bg` (code extension). `'auto'` resolves to slot parent appearance, else `'primary'`.

props.name: attention
props.description: Figma attention level — high (bold fill), medium (subtle/tinted fill), low (ghost/transparent). Default: 'high'.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test automation id — forwarded to the root `<span role="status">`.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value before showing overflow (e.g., "99+"). Default: 99. Code-only.

props.name: showZero
props.description: Whether to show the badge when value is 0. Default: false. Code-only.

props.name: size
props.description: CounterBadge size. Default: 'm'. Figma: xs | s | m | l | xl.
